Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.
Previous related experience in human resources, event coordination, or administrative support.
Experience supporting healthcare administrative operations, hospital programs, or large-scale virtual employee onboarding.

Manage operational logistics for employee experience programs, including stocking the hospital treat cart, maintaining ambassador rosters, creating newsletters, and supporting enterprise-wide events on-site.
Coordinate quarterly Mental Health First Aid courses by managing instructor schedules, setting up portal/Zoom links, tracking participant pre-work, and processing completion records.
Export, organize, and analyze monthly onboarding, exit, and engagement survey data to identify trends and report key insights to stakeholders.
Act as the virtual technical producer for New Employee Orientation, managing Zoom logistics, tracking participant attendance, facilitating breakout rooms, and sending post-orientation resources.
Proficiency with virtual meeting platforms (e.g., Zoom), learning management systems (e.g., UCLC), and survey management portals.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Teams, PowerPoint, Excel) for deck creation and data manipulation.
Strong organizational skills with demonstrated ability to process financial documents, manage inventories, and handle confidential data.
Familiarity with Gallup engagement portals, Mental Health First Aid platform administration, or HRIS reporting tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for cross-departmental coordination and newsletter/announcement drafting.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
